title: The GUM states general rules for evaluating and expressing uncertainty in measurement
summary: The GUM states general rules for evaluating and expressing uncertainty in measurement.
body: JCGM 100:2008, the Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement, says it establishes general rules for evaluating and expressing uncertainty in measurement that can be followed at various levels of accuracy and in many fields, from the shop floor to fundamental research. The source says: "s Guide establishes general rules for evaluating and expressing uncertainty in measurement that can be followed at various levels of accuracy and in many fields — from the shop floor to fundamental research." The Guide is a metrology document. It is not a theory of which scientific claims are true. Copyright in the Guide is held by the JCGM member organizations; this card paraphrases the scope sentence.

sources.title: JCGM 100:2008, Evaluation of measurement data — Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
